exercises.title: Bài luận về từ điển online (Ex. 24–25)
exercises.instruction: Đọc bài luận của học sinh và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi chỗ trống.

stimulus.text:
Many students use an online dictionary to help them learn a language when they study in class. In this essay, I (1) ____ discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this.

Firstly, if a student doesn't (2) ____ the meaning of a word or phrase, they can find it quickly and easily with an online dictionary. The teacher can continue with the class and doesn't need to stop and answer questions all the time. Furthermore, a paper dictionary is sometimes too heavy and students don't like to carry one in their bags.

On the other hand, when a student is not very confident, or if they are afraid of (3) ____ a mistake, they might start to use their dictionary in the wrong way. If they stop to (4) ____ every word or phrase they do not know, they won't (5) ____ their language skills enough and they won't improve. Additionally, it is very difficult for a teacher to check that the students are (6) ____ their computers to look (7) ____ a word and not just playing online games. If they do not focus on the class, they won't (8) ____ any progress.

To sum up, an online dictionary is often useful for students. However, in my opinion, students should only go online when the teacher says to do so. If not, they won't learn for themselves.
stimulus.caption: What are the advantages and disadvantages of using an online dictionary in a language class?

exercises.title: Viết bài luận: học tiếng Anh cùng bạn cùng quốc tịch (Ex. 27)
exercises.instruction: Viết bài luận (220–250 từ): "What are the advantages and disadvantages of taking English lessons with classmates from the same country?" Bài viết cần có: mở bài và kết luận rõ ràng; các đoạn thân bài bàn về ưu điểm và nhược điểm; từ nối để sắp xếp ý (Firstly, Furthermore, On the other hand, However, To sum up…).

checklist: Mở bài giới thiệu chủ đề và mục đích bài luận
Một đoạn ưu điểm (ít nhất 2 ý)
Một đoạn nhược điểm (ít nhất 2 ý)
Kết luận có ý kiến cá nhân
Dùng từ nối đúng chức năng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Many students want to learn English, but most of them cannot travel to an English-speaking country. Instead, they study in their own country, in classes where everybody has the same first language. In this essay, I am going to discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this.

Firstly, if a student does not understand a word or the teacher's instructions, a classmate can quickly explain it in their first language. This saves time and helps weaker students feel less worried. Furthermore, the teacher usually knows the typical problems that students from that country have, such as difficult sounds or grammar, so they can focus on these problems in every lesson. Additionally, it is often cheaper to study in your own country than to go abroad.

On the other hand, students may speak their own language too often, especially in group work, so they do not practise their English enough. Shy or lazy students might never try to communicate in English at all. Moreover, if everybody makes the same mistakes, nobody notices them, and the mistakes become habits. Finally, students do not learn about other cultures, which is an important part of learning a language.

To sum up, studying with classmates who share your first language can be helpful, because they can support you with difficult grammar and vocabulary. However, in my opinion, students in this kind of class must be very motivated and should try to use only English in the classroom if they want to make real progress.

exercises.title: Nói: ngôn ngữ bạn đang học (Ex. 13–14)
exercises.instruction: Đọc đề, chuẩn bị 1 phút, rồi nói 1–2 phút.

items.prompt:
Describe a language that you are studying, other than your first language.
You should say:
• what the language is
• how well you know the language
• how long you are going to study the language for
and explain why you are learning this language.
items.sampleAnswer: The language I'm studying at the moment is English. I started learning it in primary school, so I've studied it for about eight years, but I think my level is only pre-intermediate. I can read simple articles and I can hold a short conversation about everyday topics, but I still find listening quite difficult, especially when people speak fast. I'm going to study English for at least two more years, because I'm going to take the IELTS test before I finish high school. My plan is to practise my skills every day – for example, I'm going to watch one video online and learn ten new words each evening. The main reason I'm learning English is that I want to study abroad, maybe in Australia. Also, English gives you more job opportunities, and it helps me talk to people from all over the world, so I think it's really worth the effort.
items.sampleNote: Đủ 4 ý; dùng going to cho kế hoạch, collocation (hold a conversation, practise my skills, worth the effort), có lý do cụ thể.

exercises.title: Nói: câu hỏi về việc học ngôn ngữ (Ex. 2, 5)

items.prompt: Which ways of learning English work best for you? Why?
items.sampleAnswer: Watching videos online works best for me, because I can learn real English and it's fun. I also keep a vocabulary notebook, so I can review new words before tests.

items.prompt: Do you prefer to communicate by phone or by email?
items.sampleAnswer: I prefer to communicate by phone, because it's faster and I can hear the other person's voice. I only use email for school or when I need to send documents.
items.sampleNote: Lựa chọn + lý do + ngoại lệ.

items.prompt: What are you going to do to improve your English next month?
items.sampleAnswer: Next month, I'm going to join an English club at school, and I'm going to read one short book in English. I think speaking with other students will help me become more confident.
